short_description: Cinemark's large-format brand. 1.90:1 native aspect ratio on screens over 70 ft corner-to-corner. 4K Barco laser projection (post-2022 installs), Auro 11.1 audio, 50,000W amplification.

default_projection.effective_resolution_label: 4K DCI. Post-2022 installs: Barco SP4K-15C (17,000 lm) or SP4K-20B (21,000 lm) RGB laser. Pre-2022: Barco DP2K/DP4K xenon.
default_projection.contrast_notes: 2,000:1 is the floor for legacy xenon and SP4K-20B standard mode. Barco SP4K-15C laser (current new installs) = 2,700:1 native. No high-contrast lens configuration confirmed for XD. Brightness ~16 fL derived from Barco SP4K-15C (17,000 lm) or SP4K-20B (21,000 lm); 70 ft corner-to-corner screen requires high-gain material to meet DCI 14 fL — exact fL is venue-dependent.

known_limitations: Aspect ratio 1.90:1 (same as IMAX digital) — 1.85:1 flat DCPs display with minimal pillarboxing; scope 2.39:1 DCPs letterbox on the 1.90:1 screen.

Screen size: Cinemark cites 'over 70 ft corner-to-corner' as the canonical XD spec (corner-to-corner diagonal, not face width). First-generation XD installs (2009) were ~67 ft wide. Varies by location.

Brightness ~16 fL is a derived estimate from Barco SP4K-15C/20B specs + screen geometry. Cinemark does not publish a brightness target. High-gain screen material required at this screen size to meet DCI 14 fL.
Contrast 2,000:1 is the floor (legacy xenon / SP4K-20B standard mode); Barco SP4K-15C laser native = 2,700:1 at modern XD installations. No high-contrast lens configuration confirmed for XD.
Pre-2022 XD installations use Barco DP2K/DP4K xenon projectors; post-2022 upgrades use Barco SP4K Series 4 laser. THX certification at many but not all auditoriums.
Audio: 11.1 Auro 3D / AuroMax is standard for new builds. Some older/smaller XD installs have 7.1. Content decoded from Dolby Atmos (IAB) DCPs via the Auro speaker layout.
